'''Jono Monroe Uterus' Scum For Life 2 0''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Jono Monroe]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-12841">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12841 Uterus' Scum For Life 2 0], DeckTech (Jono "comp-uterus" Monroe, 12 January 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/12841/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/12841/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018073715/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12841/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jono Monroe]]
* '''Published:''' 12 January 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Uterus' Scum For Life 2 0''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|JPSD-D-mykindofscum.gif|label=My Kind Of Scum}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 MKOS Monroe DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' My Kind of Scum/Fearless and InventiveNOTEThis is NOT a swarm deck.  Please keep that in mind.
